worker_err_not_configured: No self-hosted worker is connected. Set one up in Settings → Publishing.
worker_err_offline: The worker cannot be reached. Check that it is running and that the URL is correct.
worker_err_auth: The worker refused the request: the shared secret does not match (or this computer's clock is more than 5 minutes off).
worker_err_rate_limited: The worker is rate limiting this computer. Try again in a few minutes.
worker_err_http: The worker answered with an error ({code}).
worker_err_pairing: That pairing string is not valid. Copy the whole string starting with mdw1:.
worker_err_secret: Paste the worker secret (at least 32 characters) or a pairing string.
worker_err_url: Enter the worker address, for example https://worker.example.com.
worker_err_platform: The worker can publish to Instagram, Facebook and Threads only ({platform} is not supported).
worker_err_no_token: There is no token for this account. Connect the account first, or paste a dedicated worker token.
worker_err_broad_scopes: This token can do more than publish ({scopes}). Create a dedicated publishing token, or tick "Allow a broader token".
worker_err_missing_scopes: This token cannot publish: it lacks {scopes}.
worker_err_token_rejected: Meta rejected this token on the worker. Reconnect the account or create a new token.
worker_err_convert: This image must be converted to JPEG for Instagram, which is not possible here.
worker_err_media_host: This post needs public media URLs. Set MD_PUBLIC_URL on the worker, or set up a media host in Settings → Publishing.
worker_sync_partial: {n} item(s) could not be synced with the worker.
worker_missed: Missed: the worker was not running at the scheduled time. Publish it now or reschedule it.
worker_container_timeout: Meta took more than 60 minutes to process the media.
worker_quota: The 24-hour publishing limit is reached. The worker retries later.
worker_token_missing: The worker has no token for this account. Send one from Settings → Publishing → Self-hosted worker.
worker_token_invalid: The worker's token for this account is invalid or expired. Send a new one from Settings.
worker_first_comment_failed: Published, but the worker could not add the first comment.
worker_failed_detail: The worker could not publish this post: {detail}
worker_notify_failed_one: {names} could not be published by the worker.
worker_notify_failed_many: {n} posts could not be published by the worker: {names}
worker_notify_offline: The worker has not been reachable for a while; {n} post(s) are waiting on it.
